title: People in a group
summary: Lists the people in a group and the people invited who have not joined. An admin sets each person to one of three roles: Admin, Moderador or Membro. An admin or a moderator takes people out, bans them and cancels invites.

person.description: The person. displayName falls back to RoomMember.displayName, then the @.

membership.description: MembershipState join, invite or ban. Other states are not listed.

role.description: From the power level (registries/group-power-levels.json, bipe-chat/bipe#733): a creator or a level of at least BipeGroupPowerLevels.admin is admin, at least moderator is moderator, else member. A level between two roles shows the lower one. The row shows bipe_app_group_admin or bipe_app_group_moderator.

isYou.description: The own user: bipe_app_you on the row, no action sheet.

nameAmbiguous.description: RoomMember.isNameAmbiguous, or another member has the same name after NameNormalizer (bipe#825). The row shows the @ after the name, as in timeline-rows.

query.description: Filters both lists by name or @.

joined.description: Under bipe_app_group_members_joined. Admins first, then by name.

banned.description: Under bipe_app_group_members_banned, by name (bipe-chat/bipe#675). Shown only when canBan and not empty.

customRoles.description: Another Matrix app set permissions off the three roles: RoomPowerLevels.values kick, ban or redact is not BipeGroupPowerLevels.moderator, or a person's level is not one of the three roles. Shows bipe_app_group_roles_custom above the list. The app does not rewrite the levels.

loading.description: true until the first members list arrives.

appear.effect: Room.members, then RoomMembersIterator.nextChunk until it is empty. Room.membersNoSync first, to show the cached list at once.

setQuery.effect: Filters the lists on the device.

openMember.effect: Opens the action sheet of the person (see notes). For the own user, does nothing.

remove.effect: Confirms with bipe_app_group_member_remove_body, then Room.kickUser with no reason.

ban.effect: Confirms with bipe_app_group_member_ban_body, then Room.banUser with no reason.

unban.effect: The only row of a banned person's sheet, bipe_app_group_member_unban, when canBan. Confirms with bipe_app_group_member_unban as title and bipe_app_group_member_unban_body, then Room.unbanUser with no reason. The person can come back with a new invite (bipe-chat/bipe#675).

cancelInvite.effect: Room.kickUser, which withdraws a pending invite in Matrix.

notes: Action sheet rows, top to bottom, each only when allowed: bipe_app_group_member_profile (always); for a joined person whose level is below the user's: the two roles the person does not have, from bipe_app_group_member_make_admin, bipe_app_group_member_make_moderator, bipe_app_group_member_remove_admin (admin to member) and bipe_app_group_member_remove_moderator (moderator to member), when canChangeRoles; then bipe_app_group_member_remove (canKick) and bipe_app_group_member_ban (canBan); for an invited person, bipe_app_group_member_cancel_invite (canKick). Matrix refuses to kick, ban or change the role of a person at or above the user's level, so the sheet has no such rows.

Three roles in the UI (bipe-chat/bipe#733). Admin changes roles and group settings and notifies everyone with @room. Moderador removes and bans members, deletes other people's messages and pins messages. Membro posts, reacts and replies. No numbers and no custom levels. A creator (room version 12) shows as admin and has no role actions. Nobody changes their own role, so a group always keeps its admins.
Remove and ban are destructive: the confirm button uses the destructive style. A failed call shows bipe_app_group_member_error and changes nothing on the screen.
Slow mode and reports to group admins need server work (#74).
Only for a group (RoomInfo.isDm false, ADR 0141). A DM has no member list.
